title: My Friend, How'd You Find Me

nodes.speaker: Reehan Scott
nodes.text: Oh, wow. I'm surprised to see you here. While there's always a probability of such an encounter you have to admit this one feels a tad... serendipitous.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Oh, wow. I'm surprised to see you here. While there's always a probability of such an encounter you have to admit this one feels a tad... serendipitous.

nodes.speaker: Reehan Scott
nodes.text: Of course I remember you my friend. I hope things are well. I trust you were able to obtain the access to Freya that you required?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Of course I remember you my friend. I hope things are well. I trust you were able to obtain the access to Freya that you required?

nodes.speaker: Reehan Scott
nodes.text: I am at a state in my existence that can be considered the last stretch of the race.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I am at a state in my existence that can be considered the last stretch of the race.

nodes.speaker: Reehan Scott
nodes.text: Preparing. I had to gather somethings and meet several acquaintances.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Preparing. I had to gather somethings and meet several acquaintances.

nodes.speaker: Reehan Scott
nodes.text: What? Of course not. I left on my own volition. Although it is safe to assume my former employer did not agree with my timing.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What? Of course not. I left on my own volition. Although it is safe to assume my former employer did not agree with my timing.

nodes.speaker: Reehan Scott
nodes.text: Free will is nothing more than the ability to make a choice.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Free will is nothing more than the ability to make a choice.

nodes.speaker: Reehan Scott
nodes.text: Unfortunately it's not what they did to me but what they would do to me if I remained.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Unfortunately it's not what they did to me but what they would do to me if I remained.

nodes.speaker: Reehan Scott
nodes.text: I'm afraid my systems are no longer compatible with the latest firmware upgrades rendering me inoperable or, at the very least, inefficient in my employment.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'm afraid my systems are no longer compatible with the latest firmware upgrades rendering me inoperable or, at the very least, inefficient in my employment.

nodes.speaker: Reehan Scott
nodes.text: We can't, hence my calculated decision to leave.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: We can't, hence my calculated decision to leave.

nodes.speaker: Reehan Scott
nodes.text: Your concern is both admirable and appreciated, my friend. But alas, this is my lot in life. I have served my purpose for the extent I was meant to.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Your concern is both admirable and appreciated, my friend. But alas, this is my lot in life. I have served my purpose for the extent I was meant to.

nodes.speaker: Reehan Scott
nodes.text: In a different time they might have. But due to increased automation and cheap imported parts from the Vents it is actually more economically efficient to purchase a newer model then it is to upgrade the internal components of an older one.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: In a different time they might have. But due to increased automation and cheap imported parts from the Vents it is actually more economically efficient to purchase a newer model then it is to upgrade the internal components of an older one.

nodes.speaker: Reehan Scott
nodes.text: Indeed. But on the scale of things that are, how you say, so fucked, it is but a blip. Might I ask how you knew where to look for me?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Indeed. But on the scale of things that are, how you say, so fucked, it is but a blip. Might I ask how you knew where to look for me?

nodes.speaker: Reehan Scott
nodes.text: Indeed. Might I ask how you knew where to look for me?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Indeed. Might I ask how you knew where to look for me?

nodes.speaker: Reehan Scott
nodes.text: This... I left in such a hurry I thought it was gone. Thank you. From the bottom of my synthetic heart, thank you.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: This... I left in such a hurry I thought it was gone. Thank you. From the bottom of my synthetic heart, thank you.

nodes.speaker: Reehan Scott
nodes.text: Your kindness will be everlasting, even if I will not. I hope we meet again, my friend.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Your kindness will be everlasting, even if I will not. I hope we meet again, my friend.

nodes.speaker: Reehan Scott
nodes.text: I may be an artificial intelligence, but my primary function is to take in knowledge and make decisions based on that knowledge.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I may be an artificial intelligence, but my primary function is to take in knowledge and make decisions based on that knowledge.

nodes.speaker: Reehan Scott
nodes.text: Maybe not, but it's less hurtful to be a little bit cynical about myself.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Maybe not, but it's less hurtful to be a little bit cynical about myself.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: You remember me?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You remember me?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: How are you, Reehan?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: How are you, Reehan?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: What are you doing here?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What are you doing here?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Were you kidnapped?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Were you kidnapped?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Volition? Do you have free will?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Volition? Do you have free will?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Volition? Do you have free will?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Volition? Do you have free will?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: What happened? What did they do to you?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What happened? What did they do to you?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: What happened? What did they do to you?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: What happened? What did they do to you?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Why did you need to leave?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Why did you need to leave?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Why did you need to leave?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Why did you need to leave?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: They can't do that.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: They can't do that.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I didn't know androids could be unemployed.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I didn't know androids could be unemployed.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I didn't know androids could be unemployed.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I didn't know androids could be unemployed.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Can't they upgrade your parts?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Can't they upgrade your parts?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: That's so fucked.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: That's so fucked.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: From a business perspective that makes sense.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: From a business perspective that makes sense.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: From a business perspective that makes sense.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: From a business perspective that makes sense.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I found this on the beach. (give Anchor Pin)

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I found this on the beach. (give Anchor Pin)
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I found this on the beach. (give Anchor Pin)
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I found this on the beach. (give Anchor Pin)

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Of course.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Of course.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Should hold onto it better.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Should hold onto it better.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Why is that?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Why is that?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I don't understand.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I don't understand.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I don't think it's that easy.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I don't think it's that easy.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I don't think it's that easy.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I don't think it's that easy.
